pedagogical_depth.justification: Strict L4 met. (a) Multi-step planning in writing BEFORE building: L5 Phase 1 has child draw and loop their core on the worksheet before building. (b) Student self-checking by the student themselves: L5 Phase 1 'loop your core to show you can spot it' is the self-check; Phase 5 'find ONE thing on your worksheet to fix' is explicit self-revision. (c) Justification step: L5 Phase 4 child reads parade aloud, explains the core, walks partner through, asks them to find missing — explanation in spoken form. (d) Explicit revision opportunity: L5 Phase 5 'find ONE thing to revise' as a separately-numbered action step. 5 distinct worksheet response types (≥4 required). Both mid-unit gate (formative_worksheets has 1) AND unit-level reflection sheet (5 prompts) present.

instructional_balance.justification: Strict L4 met. CRA progression visible: concrete (clap/stomp bodies, animal cards) → representational (parade strips, loop) → abstract (partner explanation, written extension to cell 20). L5 now contains the explicit 4-stage cycle as separately-numbered action steps: Phase 1 PLAN on paper → Phases 2-3 TEST on paper (build, translate) → Phase 4 TEST WITH MOVEMENT (lead with partner) → Phase 5 REFINE on paper + REFLECT. Each named explicitly in the step's instruction.
